== What changed on the image ==
[[File:ANH-L-sorryaboutthemess-PC-Errata-disc-changes.png|none|900px|Before and after]]
Compared with [[Sorry About The Mess (PC Errata 2018 E card)]] (by 8 July 2018): The game text changes: “weapon, as if a character with” becomes “weapon using”. These are the same words as [[Sorry About The Mess (Decipher Errata 1998)|Decipher's errata]]. The game text is set again and the white “E” in the lower border is gone; a small round bronze disc sits in the lower right corner of the card.

The whole earlier image and the whole new image, both scaled to 500 pixels wide; nothing else is edited.
